key_objects.name_zh: Hartogs 延拓构造：ρ<1/√2 情形
key_objects.name_en: Hartogs extension construction when rho < 1/sqrt(2)

key_objects.name_zh: Hartogs 延拓的阶梯推进
key_objects.name_en: Hartogs extension staircase

key_objects.name_zh: Hartogs 证明中的迭代区域 R_k
key_objects.name_en: iterated regions R_k in the Hartogs proof
key_objects.description: Choose a_k,b_k near alpha_k,beta_k and repeatedly apply Lemma 2.2 to enlarge R_k until R_N is the entire unit ball.

key_objects.name_zh: 多复变中无孤立奇点与孤立零点
key_objects.name_en: no isolated singularities or isolated zeros in several variables
key_objects.description: For n>1, Hartogs extension rules out isolated singularities; applying it to 1/f rules out isolated zeros. The zero set of a nonzero holomorphic function must reach the domain boundary.

key_objects.name_zh: Hartogs 定理：非齐次 Cauchy-Riemann 方程
key_objects.name_en: Hartogs theorem: the inhomogeneous Cauchy-Riemann equations
key_objects.description: Uses compactly supported solutions of the inhomogeneous dbar system to correct a non-holomorphic cutoff extension.

key_objects.name_zh: 非齐次 Cauchy-Riemann 方程组
key_objects.name_en: inhomogeneous Cauchy-Riemann system

key_objects.name_zh: 一维非齐次 dbar 方程
key_objects.name_en: one-dimensional inhomogeneous dbar equation

key_objects.name_zh: 一维 dbar 方程的 Cauchy 变换解
key_objects.name_en: Cauchy-transform solution of the one-dimensional dbar equation

key_objects.name_zh: 一维 dbar 方程的解与唯一性性质
key_objects.name_en: solution properties for the one-dimensional dbar equation
key_objects.statement: For continuous compactly supported f, the Cauchy-transform u is continuous and solves dbar u=f distributionally; C^k regularity is preserved; every compactly supported C^1 u satisfies u=(dbar u)*Φ.

key_objects.name_zh: Φ(z)=1/(πz) 是 dbar 的基本解
key_objects.name_en: Phi(z)=1/(pi z) as a fundamental solution of dbar

key_objects.name_zh: 高维非齐次 dbar 方程的相容条件
key_objects.name_en: compatibility condition for the higher-dimensional dbar system

key_objects.name_zh: 高维 dbar 方程的紧支撑解
key_objects.name_en: compactly supported solution of the higher-dimensional dbar system
key_objects.statement: For n≥2, compactly supported C^k functions f_j satisfying the compatibility conditions admit a compactly supported C^k solution u of dbar u=f.

key_objects.name_zh: Proposition 3.2 的显式解
key_objects.name_en: explicit solution used in Proposition 3.2

key_objects.name_zh: 紧支撑 dbar 解的一维/高维差异
key_objects.name_en: dimension-dependent compact-support behavior for dbar solutions
key_objects.description: In one complex variable compact support generally requires moment conditions such as ∫f dm=0; for n≥2 the compactly supported solution furnished by Proposition 3.2 exists and is unique.

key_objects.name_zh: Hartogs 紧集挖洞延拓定理
key_objects.name_en: Hartogs extension across a compact hole
key_objects.statement: If Ω⊂C^n is bounded, n≥2, K⊂Ω is compact, and Ω−K is connected, then every holomorphic F0 on Ω−K extends holomorphically to Ω.

key_objects.name_zh: cutoff + dbar 修正的 Hartogs 证明机制
key_objects.name_en: cutoff plus dbar correction in the Hartogs proof
key_objects.description: Choose a smooth cutoff η, form F1=ηF0 near Ω−K and 0 near K, set f_j=dbar_j F1, solve dbar u=f with compact support, and put F=F1−u.

key_objects.name_zh: cutoff 延拓的 dbar 误差
key_objects.name_en: dbar error of the cutoff extension

key_objects.name_zh: Hartogs 证明中 u 在 Ω∩B_ε 上消失
key_objects.name_en: u vanishes on Omega intersect B_epsilon in the Hartogs proof

key_objects.name_zh: 边界版本：切向 Cauchy-Riemann 方程
key_objects.name_en: A boundary version: the tangential Cauchy-Riemann equations
key_objects.description: Studies which boundary functions extend holomorphically by using defining functions, tangential vector fields, and the tangential dbar system.

key_objects.name_zh: 区域的定义函数 ρ
key_objects.name_en: defining function rho of a region
key_objects.description: A real-valued function ρ with ρ<0 on Ω, ρ=0 on ∂Ω, and ρ>0 on Ω^c.

key_objects.name_zh: C^k 边界
key_objects.name_en: boundary of class C^k
key_objects.description: Ω has C^k boundary when it admits a C^k defining function ρ with |∇ρ|>0 on ∂Ω.

key_objects.name_zh: C^k 局部超曲面
key_objects.name_en: local hypersurface of class C^k
key_objects.description: Locally M={ρ=0} for a real C^k function with nonvanishing gradient on M.

key_objects.name_zh: 边界的局部图表示
key_objects.name_en: local graph representation of the boundary

key_objects.name_zh: 局部坐标中的 Ω 与边界图
key_objects.name_en: Omega and its boundary in local graph coordinates

key_objects.name_zh: 两个定义函数的局部比例关系
key_objects.name_en: local proportionality of defining functions

key_objects.name_zh: 切向向量场
key_objects.name_en: tangential vector field
key_objects.description: A vector field X=Σ a_j(x)∂/∂x_j is tangential to ∂Ω when X(ρ)=0 on ∂Ω; this is independent of the defining function.

key_objects.name_zh: 边界上的 C^ℓ 函数
key_objects.name_en: C^ell function on the boundary
key_objects.description: A boundary function f0 is C^ℓ if it extends to a C^ℓ function on R^d; tangential derivatives are independent of the chosen extension.

key_objects.name_zh: Cauchy-Riemann 向量场
key_objects.name_en: Cauchy-Riemann vector field
key_objects.description: On C^n, a Cauchy-Riemann vector field has the form X=Σ a_j(z)∂/∂\bar z_j; equivalently it annihilates every holomorphic function.

key_objects.name_zh: 切向 Cauchy-Riemann 向量场条件
key_objects.name_en: tangency condition for a Cauchy-Riemann vector field

key_objects.name_zh: 局部切向 Cauchy-Riemann 向量场基
key_objects.name_en: local basis of tangential Cauchy-Riemann vector fields

key_objects.name_zh: 全局切向 Cauchy-Riemann 生成族
key_objects.name_en: global spanning family of tangential Cauchy-Riemann vector fields

key_objects.name_zh: dbar 的微分形式记号
key_objects.name_en: dbar notation with differential forms
key_objects.description: Write dbar u=f with dbar u=Σ(∂u/∂\bar z_j)d\bar z_j; for a (0,1)-form w=Σw_j d\bar z_j define dbar w as a (0,2)-form. The displayed expansion continues to PDF 311.
